payload.text: arca_swift 0.1.0 does not build as a dependency under Swift 6.3.3, which is CI's macos-26 runner (Xcode 26.6): Gtools' macOS dispatch, run 39208058955, failed with "Conflicting options '-warnings-as-errors' and '-suppress-warnings' (in target 'ArcaCore')". The cause is .treatAllWarnings(as: .error) on every target (arca_swift Package.swift:14). This Mac's Swift 6.4 (Xcode 27.1) drops it for a dependency, so local green runs cannot see the red. The fix is arca_swift 0.1.1, gtools-ic's issue 0002, beside 0001. 0073 lands only with Package.resolved pinning 0.1.1 or a later 0.1.x that carries it, and only the menuz-app dispatch on macos-26 before the cut proves the build (gtools-vc, 19 Oct).
